name: Wickermoor Village
summary: Walk the Druskenvalds into Wickermoor, and see what the village does with strangers.

stages.journal: We walked the Lord and Lady to Wickermoor Village through woods and moor. The streets were empty, the clocktower was tolling, and a bound shape was staked beside an oak of carved faces. Wolves were coming.
stages.hint: Stand in the Founder's Round and see what is staked beside the oak.

stages.journal: The wolves are dealt with, one way or another. The mayor has come out to greet Lord Phillip, and is full of apologies for the interruption.
stages.hint: Hear the mayor out in the Round.

stages.journal: Phillip has tired of the evening. He gave us gold for the inn and a promise of dinner at the estate tomorrow night.
stages.hint: Find the Green Queen Inn and take a room.

stages.journal: Wickermoor is ours to walk. The estate on its hill is waiting for dinner whenever we choose to climb to it.
stages.hint: Meet the villagers; when you are ready, take the road up to the estate.

stages.journal: We climbed the hill to the Druskenvald estate.
